metadata.title: Carrier No-Go Theorems for Two-Degree-of-Freedom MOND: the F(A²) Class, the Auxiliary-Legendre Escape, and a Hamiltonian Audit of Causal Nonlocal MOND
metadata.description:
Preprint. This deposit timestamps three structural results with their reproducibility scripts; it is not a journal publication and makes no viability claim for any MOND theory.

(1) F(A²) no-go theorem. For the single-invariant khronon carrier L = a₀²F(A²/a₀²) on a hypersurface-orthogonal preferred foliation, the scalar velocity-Hessian kernel is Zij = F′δij + (2F″/a₀²)āiāj, det Z = F′²(F′+2sF″). A genuine constant-rank scalar-removing degeneracy forces F′ = F″ = 0, hence F = const: wherever MOND is active (μ<1), Z⊥ = 2(1−μ) > 0 and the khronon propagates. Adversarially verified on FLRW and Bianchi-I backgrounds (θ, σ are invariants orthogonal to A²); isolated zeros of the longitudinal eigenvalue are strong-coupling surfaces, not Dirac constraints. This is the quadratic-order mechanism behind the acceleration-free structure of the admissible two-DOF spatially-covariant branches and explains structurally why relativistic khronon MOND carries a third mode. Scope: local, regular, hypersurface-orthogonal, single-invariant; multi-invariant carriers, extra fields, and twisting congruences remain open.

(2) The auxiliary-Legendre escape. The pair L = −χ|DΦ|² − V(χ), V the Legendre dual of any monotone interpolation, carries the identical MOND nonlinearity with ZERO propagating degrees of freedom: the Dirac Pfaffian N√h[2(ḿ·k)² − V″χk²] is strictly positive because the Legendre relation forces V″ < 0. Nonlinearity in a constraint bracket removes a mode; the same nonlinearity in a kinetic Hessian propagates one.

(3) Hamiltonian audit of the 2026 causal-nonlocal (Deffayet–Woodard-type) MOND architecture (exact-exponential branch μ = 1−e−y), which contains no published Hamiltonian analysis: (a) full canonical count 2 tensor + 2 scalar, one scalar the localization ghost ((U,ξ) block det = −b² < 0, background-independent), with a numeric proof that the retarded prescription is history-dependent and hence NOT a Dirac constraint — the ghost is demoted (zero free retarded Cauchy data at linear order) but survives in phase space; (b) an external-field localization theorem: Z[g] localizes to 4(gtotal/a₀)² in a bound system in an external field (nonlocal remnants ≤8%), so the EFE quadrupole is governed by 1−μ at the UNSCREENED external field yext ≈ 1.9, giving Q₂ ≈ 2×10−26 s−2 vs the 2026 Cassini ceiling 5.2×10−27 — a 10–14σ structural exclusion of the branch, on a gate the published construction defers; (c) a reverse-arrow theorem: any de Sitter fixed point fixes H*/a₀ from the shape of f, so the construction determines ρDE FROM a₀, never conversely — a₀ is provably a free parameter and its cosmological branch is w = 0 dust; (d) on FLRW the double-timelike projection Rμνuμuν yields an αT-type tensor operator with cT²−1 ≈ +4×10−2 (cT = 1 exactly on Minkowski); (e) favorably, the cosmology↔MOND crossing Z = 0 is regular in the physical field including the transport sector, and the exact-exponential weak-field sector is elliptic everywhere.

What is not claimed: no statement about multi-invariant or extra-field carriers; no derivation of the coefficient κ or Z in a₀ = κc√(GρΛ) (fitted throughout); no observational confirmation of MOND. A constructive counterpart (a conditionally closed constraint-defined MOND MMG) appears in a companion deposit.

AI-assistance disclosure. Portions of the analysis, numerical verification and drafting were carried out with the assistance of large language models (Anthropic Claude and others). The author directed the work, specified and reviewed every load-bearing calculation, and takes full responsibility including for any errors. Several intermediate claims produced during the work were found to be incorrect and were withdrawn before this deposit. No AI system is listed as an author.

Reproducibility. Every load-bearing claim is produced by a committed script that exits nonzero if any internal check fails; the seven scripts are included in this deposit.
metadata.notes: Preprint; construction + no-go results with reproducibility scripts. kappa and Z are fitted, never derived. The Cassini result excludes the exact-exponential branch of the causal-nonlocal chassis; it is not a claim that all nonlocal MOND is excluded. Companion deposit: A Conditionally Closed Constraint-Defined MOND Theory with Two Tensor Degrees of Freedom.
